steps.name: Contestant A
steps.text: Bro, maybe we should just go back to the Pioneer Team...

steps.name: Contestant A
steps.text: Our fowlbeasts might be great at helping out with hunting and whatnot, but that's nothing to the city folks. They aren't gonna like 'em!

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: Don't say that!

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: How can you be so sure it won't work out before you try? What if that's exactly what they're into these days? Look at that girl there... She brought a whole gang of Metal Crabs! What are you so scared of?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hey, I can hear you, you know!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: You better watch out, or Peacake is going to bite you!

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Feigns ferociousness and waves claws)

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: Er, my bad, my bad—I didn't mean it like that, I was just trying to console him. Didn't expect you to hear me.

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: But I mean it, miss. Don't you think having ferocious fowlbeasts doing tricks could open up a whole new market?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hm... I don't really know.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: But like you said, I am bringing Metal Crabs to this contest, and fowlbeasts are more of a usual pet. You guys might just make it.

spans.text: bringing Metal Crabs to this contest, and fowlbeasts are more of a usual pet. You guys might just make it.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hehe, and I just came up with an idea. Wanna hear it?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: If you guys want to put on a good show, how about you work with me? I'll lend you some of my strongest crabs. They can work with your fowlbeasts and put on an amazing fight together!

steps.name: Contestant A
steps.text: Huh? That's awfully generous. For real?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Yep. I'm here to make a name for my Metal Crabs so that more people out there know how amazing they are.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: If you guys make it big here, my crabs will follow suit and get famous too, right?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: And even if it doesn't work out, they'll have learned some new tricks working with you guys. Either way, it's a win for me.

steps.name: Contestant A
steps.text: *whimpers*, thank you!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: C'mon, the waiting times are long here. We've still got plenty of time for you to break the ice with them. Let me teach you what they can do!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Okay, focus, little guys! This is the waiting area, so let's start the training. And if you're good little boys and girls, I've got some treats waiting. The fancy stuff!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: If anyone's not feeling well, now's the time to speak up!

steps.name: Contestant A
steps.text: Huh? They can talk?

steps.name: Trey & Twista
steps.text: (Move left claws and knock on their heads)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hm, the flowers on your heads not feeling so good? Let me take a look.

steps.name: Hammer
steps.text: (Turns around on the spot and lifts claw)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: A rock scraped your leg? Ahh—There's a pebble stuck here!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Good job, Hammer. Be sure to let me know if you're not feeling okay anywhere. Don't be like Ice Cube, trying to tough it out without telling me.

steps.name: Ice Cube
steps.text: (Stomps the ground)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Aw, don't be like that, you've been doing wonderful too!

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Amazing, isn't it? I call this 'Clawspeak.' We've got our own unique way to communicate!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Watch this. (Puts right hand forward and swings it around)

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Turns right)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Poses like she's drinking water)

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Hauls a bottle of springwater to her)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Just like that! Impressed? Aside from these daily life commands, they know even more for when I'm at work. They even come with me on some pretty difficult operations sometimes!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: That's why I put together a special program just for this. Three minutes of showing off their ability to freely change their formation and follow all kinds of commands, then they'll interact with the judges for the last two.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: I'll teach the judges a few commands to give to them, but until I give the order, the Metal Crabs won't listen to anyone else. That'll show just how professional they are!

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: Now I'm starting to get anxious. Pete, we gotta head back and work on our own show!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hehe! I haven't been doing this for years for nothing!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Hrm...

steps.name: Organizer
steps.text: Which one do you have your eyes on?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: The girl brought who Metal Crabs. You don't see those every day. Unique!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Those furry beastlings have dominated the market for far too long. It's time for a new kind of pet: stranger, more exotic, and with more impact!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Slap on a few gimmicks and slogans, and we can jack up the price all we want. 'A perfect pet that executes all your commands perfectly.' How's that?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: A terror of the wilderness, now at your beck and call with a cute flower on its head. Yeah, this will work!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Miss Beanstalk. That's a cute name you've got.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: May I ask what this is about?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: First, here's our advertising contract. Please take a look at it.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: We've gone over the resume you submitted. I see you tried to sell something called 'Beanstalk's Fine Pet Food’?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Yep, so what did the committee think? I did amazing, right?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Right, you did make something of an impression...

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: But it's not enough!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: The name and advertising don't have a clear theme. They're not extreme enough! They lack impact!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: The advertising copy doesn't make a strong impression, and the story doesn't have enough twists and turns to it. There's not enough to stand out from the pack!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: As a new product, both the name and the slogan have to be snappy. They need to be unique enough to grab customers by their hearts!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: We don't need any gimmicks that are already on the market. What we need is something that's never been seen before!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Which is why even the subtlest word choice need to keep their interest. An eye-opener that'll awaken the masses' desire to buy!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Ooh—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: ...So that's how it is?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Ahem!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Miss Beanstalk, we make our evaluations in many different ways. Sometimes, we select from contestants who make it through our competitions. Other times, we reach out privately. You're very fortunate to belong in that second group—You can step directly onto the stage.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: We'll provide you all the resources you'll need to distinguish your product, but you'll also need to work with us and film some commercials.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: I see you've been flipping through the contract. So what do you think of my proposal?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Yeah, your offer really moved me.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: In that case, we can go over the details of the contract, such as...

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Huh? What did you do to the funding's number—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Whoops.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Guess you fou—

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Wow, it's exactly the same as what we wrote in the first place!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Heh, you're a pretty swell guy.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Haha, hardly.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Well then, Miss Beanstalk?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Take my signature!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Nice working with you!

steps.name: Organizer
steps.text: Where have you been, and why do you smell so bad?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Gah... This is filthy!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Do you even have to ask? The Metal Crabs we just caught aren't behaving.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: I took care of the most stubborn ones already. Tch, and it got on my clothes. The ones who are left can at least follow orders—I gotta make sure we have enough in stock after the show's over.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: As for the ones the girl brought with her... She's keeping a close eye on them, though I'm guessing she wouldn't be able to tell if a few went missing.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: ...Whatever, I'm gonna go clean up. I still have to keep flattering Beanstalk and her crabs.

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Scurries over in a flurry)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Biggie? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Weren't you guys resting up at the workshop?

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Puts claw next to face and gestures)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: You mean... You can smell other Metal Crabs, but they're already dead?

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Points in the workshop's direction)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Around the back?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: There's a small shed there, but isn't that a storehouse? I've passed by it a couple times, but the door's locked. Seemed like there were only boxes in there.

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Points claw at itself)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: You mean there are other Metal Crabs trapped inside?!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whispers) Biggie, wait. Let's go somewhere no one will overhear us.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Okay, I see... I thought it'd be fine as long as I kept a close eye on you guys, but I never thought they'd go and capture wild crabs from the wastelands to train.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: And they even killed the ones that wouldn't listen to them!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: We gotta rescue them, Biggie!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: So this is where you were, Miss Beanstalk. I've been looking for you the better part of the day.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Ah, yeah.... What's the matter?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: It's time for our training, yet I find you here, slacking off, so of course I have to ask what's going on.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Oh! Right, I lost track of time.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whistles)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: We're gonna start now.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: C'mon, little buddies. Follow my command!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: 1, 2, 1, 2. Original formation—!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Now let's go through the procedure again, just like we rehearsed—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: And now for the special bonus move—

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Yep, lovely as always.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: But you really can't afford to be slacking; the real show is about to start. You've been doing very well so far, but I don't want any trouble during the key moment. I'll leave you to it.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whispers) My little buddies! I just found out about a huge problem! Biggie said he could smell dead crabs, and there are lots of wild Metal Crabs locked in the small shed behind the workshop!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whispers) Right now, we're the only ones who know about this. That's why we're going to change up our training mission. We'll work on a new formation, rescue them, and get them out of here safe and sound!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whispers) I'm counting on you, guys!

steps.name: Metal Crabs
steps.text: (Grind claws)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Pea, have you gotten the formation down? You guys need to form a chain and grab the storehouse key they left below the window!

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Swings claws)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Biggie, Twista. You know what you're doing?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Tomorrow's the dress rehearsal. As soon as those dudes in black step on the stage, you guys are gonna snap the support pillars and send them plunging down!

steps.name: B.I.G. & Twista
steps.text: (Swing flowers)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Okay! Most importantly, remember that you gotta be stealthy with all this. Do not let anyone spot you. Your own safety is top priority!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Once everything's over, I'll give you guys the highest grade canned pet food!

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Stealthily commands)

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Carefully climbs)

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Formation successful!)

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Climbs up its buddies and onto the desk and reaches the key!)

steps.name: Key
steps.text: (Impact sound)

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: What's that noise?

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Quickly turns around and hides in a crevice in the wall with the key like a G before the staff worker notices!)

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Mission accomplished)

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Disappears coolly into the shadows with its buddies)

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Scurries around frantically)

steps.name: Twista
steps.text: *snip*? (Yo, hold up. This ain't our mission, is it?)

spans.text: Yo, hold up. This ain't our mission, is it?

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Frantically swings claws)

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Tearfully complains as though he went through it all himself)

steps.name: Twista
steps.text: (Continues to seek help)

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: ! (So that's where the kid from the tree hole next door bounced!)

spans.text: So that's where the kid from the tree hole next door bounced!

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: *snip*. (Wait... you look familiar.)

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: *snip* *snip*? (You the kid of that big flower punk who used to live in the rock fissure?)

spans.text: You the kid of that big flower punk who used to live in the rock fissure?

steps.name: B.I.G.
steps.text: (Blanks out momentarily and then happily spins around)

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: *snip* *snip*!! (Homies, my uncle's neighbor's cousin's kid's in trouble!)

spans.text: Homies, my uncle's neighbor's cousin's kid's in trouble!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Okay, Pea? After I open the door, make sure you tell the wild Metal Crabs what I'm saying. I can't be certain they won't attack humans on sight after everything they've been through.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: If they escape now, they'll just get spotted. I'll block the keyhole so that the lock stops working. As soon as they hear the stage fall apart, they need to run out of this place and head for the wilderness where they'll be safe!

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Waves claws)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Phew... Okay, I'll open the door now!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: We're here to help you. Please trust us!

steps.name: Metal Crabs in the House
steps.text: (Cower in fear together)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Ah—You guys okay?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Alright, it's time to rehearse for tomorrow's show.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: All of you have already received a copy of the program. Let's get down to it—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whistles quietly)

steps.name: B.I.G. & Twista
steps.text: (Wave claws in response)

steps.name: B.I.G. & Twista
steps.text: (Lead other the Metal Crabs onto the stage's trusses)
The Metal Crabs start sneaking into the foundations. Beanstalk waits nervously as the stage begins to creak.
Everything is going according to plan.
However, right at this moment, something unexpected happens.
B.I.G. and Twista don't stop. Instead, they climb straight onto the highest point of the stage and stand up against the wind.

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: ...Hey? What's going on?! What are the crabs doing up here?

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Beanstalk? Control your animals!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Uh... Yeah!
Beanstalk nervously whistles, asking the Metal Crabs what they are doing.
B.I.G. and Twista turn around and face the barren land behind the stage.
Unlike what she expected, the stage doesn't come tumbling down under the organizers. To the contrary, the ground under her feet starts shaking.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: (Whistles nervously once again)

steps.name: B.I.G. & Twista
steps.text: (Wave claws reassuringly)
Suddenly a huge cloud of dust is kicked up beyond the horizon. Soon thereafter, the earth begins to tremble violently—
Dozens, hundreds, or perhaps even thousands of Metal Crabs, big and small, suddenly rush into the area, all brandishing sharp claws glinting under the light.
At the highest point of the stage, the crabs lower their upraised claws and turn around to signal to Beanstalk below the stage.
The Reproba girl gets the gist, hops onto a box by her side, and starts yelling out towards the wilderness.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Hey—!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Beanstalk? What, are you nuts?!

steps.name: B.I.G. & Twista
steps.text: (Wave claws majestically at the highest point of the stage)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Biggie! Twista! Tell your buddies to pinch all their butts—!

steps.name: Contestants
steps.text: Where did they all come from?!

steps.name: Contestants
steps.text: Ahh—So many crabs!
The Metal Crabs all rush toward the stage purposefully.
The organizer starts stomping and grabbing onto anything he can to chase the creatures away. But while he might be able to stop a few of them, even more crabs start rushing toward him.
After a muffled sound, the crabs' snipping pays off and the stage crumbles down with a loud crash, kicking dust into the air.
The Metal Crabs locked inside the storehouse also rush outside and join the fray.
They rush toward the organizers and swarm the stage, even swiping a few unfinished cans of luxury pet food.

steps.name: Contestant B
steps.text: Ugh. D-Don't pinch my leg—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Don't worry, everyone! The Metal Crabs are here to help us! They're very kind, and won't hurt anyone!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Uh, I'm not so sure about the wild ones, though...

steps.name: Metal Crabs Fincatching in Troubled Waters
steps.text: (Concentrate on eating the pet food)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Er... never mind... We should run. Run—!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: We can figure this out after we escape—

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: All of you, with me!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Why you—!

steps.name: Organizing Committee Member
steps.text: Urgh—!!

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... How are you guys?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Anyone hurt? No one got flattened by debris when the stage came down?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: What about you guys from the storehouse?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Y'all okay?

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: (Communicate to each other using their claws)

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: (Gradually cluster around Beanstalk)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: You... want to follow me?

steps.name: Wild Metal Crab
steps.text: (Shake claws)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Then... I work at this place called Rhodes Island. Wanna come with us?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: I'll tell you what life is like there on the way.

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Happily swings claws around)
